card.name: Verbs and links before dose or care phrases
card.fires_on: Scattered single words in medical sentences, mostly a verb or linking word like 'require' or 'of' just before a phrase about doses or care of children. Also seen inside a drug name and on 'vaccines'.

modes.label: Verb before high doses
modes.description: The verb 'require' after 'often' in a sentence about pediatric patients and contrast doses.
modes.example: given that they often<< require>> high doses of contrast during invasive cardiac procedures

modes.label: 'of' after 'part'
modes.description: The word 'of' in 'a necessary part of' the care of children.
modes.example: Anesthetic and sedation drugs are a necessary part<< of>> the care of children needing surgery, other

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: A drug-name piece or a noun in a drug interaction list.
modes.example: CHCs have been shown to decrease plasma concentrations of acetamin<<oph>>en, clofibric acid, morph

card.plain: It fires on a few stray words in pediatric and drug text, with no single clear theme.
